name: Fast Fingers
detailed_description:
Help a Child Complete Their Homework and Dive into the World of Rhythm!

Fast Fingers places you right in the middle of a child’s homework adventure! To help this little hero finish their homework, you need to show off your fast typing skills. But this isn’t just any ordinary homework! The subject? Typing words correctly and quickly in tune with the rhythm!

🎶 Homework Shaped by Music: The child has to type texts shaped by the rhythm of the music. From Phonk’s powerful beats to TikTok’s energetic trend songs, each type of music brings a new assignment and challenge. This child’s task is tough, but with your help, it’s not impossible!

🕹️ Catch the Falling Words from the Sky! As word bubbles fall from top to bottom, type them in the correct order. Completing each word on time is critical for the child to finish their homework. But be careful, the falling words speed up, and things get even more challenging!

🔥 A Story That Evolves with Difficulty Levels: As the child’s homework words become harder with each level, the music rhythms change too. Make quick decisions, type correctly, and help the child complete their task successfully!

🌟 Learning and Fun Combined: Help the child while improving your own reflexes and typing speed. Fast Fingers brings together an educational and fun experience.

🎯 Complete the Child’s Story: Witness the child’s story unfold as they get closer to completing their homework with every level. Help them and become their hero. Have fun and be a part of a success story!

Get your fingers ready and help the child finish their homework successfully. Feel the rhythm, type, and win! Welcome to the world of Fast Fingers!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (3 GB VRAM) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (6 GB VRAM) or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX
